lines.text: until the cherries bloom again
til the leaves drip with april's foolish rains
til the ladies' nightcaps go insane
change in weather gives them spring migraines
dazed and tired
pools of pollen gather in the bay
unbugged and unwired
observations made in the light of day
til even the lame drop their canes
til the winter fog lift from our brains
until the maples bloom again
until there's everything to gain
dazed and tired
pools of pollen gather in the bay
unbugged and unwired
observation made in the light of
days melt to weeks tell me what is wrong
don't ask me where all the time has gone
until the bluebells sound again
til farina makes my nostrils flame
and my time will be yours to claim
til i see you again, dear friend

n1.body:
here i really just wrote out a bunch of seasonal references, a celebration of spring!

springtime is upon us! so much going on.

n2.body: it can be quite exhausting, the rebirth of nature

n3.body: a fresh, clear eye, the days longer.

n4.body: potential in the air, circulation picking up, muscles limbering

n5.body: the pandemic era - among uncertainty and confusion is there enjowment to be found on the chaotic ride?

n7.body:
through the lockdown i was not able to see a friend at the time for a long while and the excitement of seeing them again blends easily with the spring metaphors of new beginnings and blossoming potentials.
our grandparents planted a tree for each of us grandchildren; my sister sings the backups on this song - her tree is a cherry <3
